disciplinary_grounds.quote: Make or use any false or misleading representations or omit any material fact in the offer or sale of the services of a loan broker or engage directly or indirectly in any act that operates or would operate as fraud or deception upon any person

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Make or use any false or deceptive representation in its business dealings with a State agency or conceal a material fact from a State agency.

bonding_required.quote: Charge or receive any money or other valuable consideration prior to full and complete performance of the services the credit services organization has agreed to perform for or on behalf of the buyer unless the credit services organization has, in conformity with section 7, either obtained a surety bond issued by a surety company admitted to do business in this Commonwealth or established a trust account

definition_quote.value: A person who: (i) For or in expectation of a consideration fee arranges or attempts to arrange or offers to fund a loan of money, a credit card or line of credit for personal, family or household purposes. (ii) For or in expectation of a consideration fee assists or advises a borrower in obtaining or attempting to obtain a loan of money, a credit card, a line of credit or related guarantee, enhancement or collateral of any kind or nature. (iii) Acts for or on behalf of a loan broker for the purpose of soliciting borrowers. (iv) Holds himself out as a loan broker.
definition_quote.quote: For or in expectation of a consideration fee arranges or attempts to arrange or offers to fund a loan of money, a credit card or line of credit for personal, family or household purposes.

registration_required.quote: Loan brokers shall be registered with the Department of Banking pursuant to regulations promulgated by the department.

registration_fee_annual.quote: Loan brokers seeking to be registered by the department shall pay to the department an annual registration fee of $300.

advance_fee_prohibited.quote: Assess or collect an advance fee from a borrower to provide services as a loan broker.

surety_bond_or_trust_account_required.quote: either obtained a surety bond issued by a surety company admitted to do business in this Commonwealth or established a trust account

surety_bond_minimum_amount.quote: in no case shall the bond be less than $5,000 nor more than $25,000

surety_bond_maximum_amount.quote: in no case shall the bond be less than $5,000 nor more than $25,000

surety_bond_basis_percent_of_fees.quote: The bond or the trust account shall be in an amount equal to 5% of the total amount of the fees charged buyers by the credit services organization under the contracts entered into between the credit services organization and such buyers during the previous 12 months

written_contract_required.quote: Every contract between the buyer and a credit services organization for the purchase of the services of the credit services organization shall be in writing, shall be dated, shall be signed by the buyer

cancellation_right_days.quote: You may cancel this contract without any penalty or obligation within five days from the date the contract is signed.

pre_contract_information_sheet_required.quote: Prior to the execution of a contract or agreement between the buyer and a credit services organization or prior to the receipt by the credit services organization of any money or other valuable consideration, whichever occurs first, the credit services organization shall provide the buyer a statement in writing containing all the information required by section 5.

information_sheet_retention_years.quote: The credit services organization shall maintain on file or microfilm for a period of three years an exact copy of the information sheet

principal_liability_for_agent_acts.quote: Each principal of a loan broker may be held responsible for the actions of a loan broker, including its agents or employees in the course of business of the loan broker.

waiver_of_consumer_rights_prohibited.quote: Any waiver by a buyer or borrower of the provisions of this act shall be deemed contrary to public policy and shall be void and unenforceable. Any attempt by a credit services organization or a loan broker to have a buyer or borrower waive rights given by this act shall constitute a violation of this act.

exemption_burden_of_proof_on_claimant.quote: In any proceeding involving this act, the burden of proving an exemption or an exception from a definition is upon the person claiming it.

value: Any person organized, chartered or holding a license or authorization certificate to make loans or extensions of credit pursuant to the laws of the Commonwealth or the United States who is subject to regulation and supervision by an official or agency of the Commonwealth or the United States

Any bank, bank and trust company, trust company, savings bank, Federal savings and loan association or savings bank located in this Commonwealth or savings association or any subsidiary or affiliate of such institution whose deposits are eligible for insurance by the FDIC
Any person licensed as a mortgage broker under the Mortgage Bankers and Brokers Act
Any person who is not required to obtain a license as a mortgage banker by reason of the exceptions contained in section 3(b) of the Mortgage Bankers and Brokers Act
Any person licensed as a real estate broker where the person is acting within the course and scope of that license
Any person admitted to practice law in this Commonwealth where the person renders services within the course of such practice
Any broker-dealer registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission or the Commodity Futures Trading Commission where the broker-dealer is acting within the course and scope of such regulation
excluded_entity_types.quote: The term shall not include: (i) Any person organized, chartered, exempt from licensure under statute or holding a license or authorization certificate to make loans or provide credit pursuant to the laws of the Commonwealth or the United States who is subject to regulation and supervision by an official or agency of the Commonwealth or the United States.
